coordinate_convention.familyWarp: trunk length; localized chest/haunch/shoulder lateral profile and muscle bulge; localized neck shift

left_ear_base.label: Horse-left ear base (+Y)
left_ear_base.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
left_ear_base.note: Picked on the rendered attachment outside the forelock; horse-left is +Y.

right_ear_base.label: Horse-right ear base (-Y)
right_ear_base.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
right_ear_base.note: Picked on the rendered attachment outside the forelock; horse-right is -Y.

forelock_between_ears.label: Forelock between ears
forelock_between_ears.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
forelock_between_ears.note: Visual anchor only; hair-face partition boundaries are owned by the separate hair mapping.

left_nostril.label: Horse-left nostril (+Y)
left_nostril.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
left_nostril.note: Picked at the visible nostril depression in the frontal render; not a separate mesh boundary.

right_nostril.label: Horse-right nostril (-Y)
right_nostril.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
right_nostril.note: Picked at the visible nostril depression in the frontal render; not a separate mesh boundary.

muzzle_nose_tip.label: Muzzle / nose tip
muzzle_nose_tip.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
muzzle_nose_tip.note: Centered near the forward-most muzzle surface.

jaw_head_neck_transition.label: Behind jaw: head / neck transition
jaw_head_neck_transition.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
jaw_head_neck_transition.note: Pixel mirrors the reviewed behind-jaw location from the opposite flank; continuous sculpt, not a sharp seam.

mane_root_behind_ears_poll_end.label: Mane root behind ears (poll end)
mane_root_behind_ears_poll_end.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
mane_root_behind_ears_poll_end.note: A visible crest point behind the ears; hair boundary remains subject to the separate hair-segmentation map.

mane_end_near_withers.label: Mane end near withers
mane_end_near_withers.method: rendered-image pixel ray cast to frontmost evaluated scene geometry
mane_end_near_withers.note: Visible crest endpoint near withers; do not treat the old separate Mane-object bounds as full mane anatomy.

scope_note: Every saved point is selected in a rendered view and ray-cast to visible evaluated geometry. Soft anatomical transitions and hair region boundaries remain visual anchors, not exact segmentation boundaries; see the senior hair-face map when available.
